import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
work = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess')
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-training-controller-20261004'
target = directory / 'learning-gates.json'
assert not target.exists()
started = time.perf_counter()

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

result = json.loads((directory / 'result.json').read_text())
assert result['status'] == 'completed-awaiting-learning-gates-no-games'
profile = result['profile']
assert digest(work / 'run-ufuk-broad-v4-controlled-training.py') == profile['controller_sha256']
assert digest(work / 'audit-ufuk-broad-v4-production-resume.py') == profile['resume_audit_script_sha256']
assert digest(root / 'docs/runs/UFUK-broad-history-training-preregistration-20261004.md') == profile['preregistration_sha256']
assert [[r['seed'], r['arm']] for r in result['runs']] == profile['order']
assert len(result['audits']) == 4
assert all(a['result']['status'] == 'pass' and all(a['result']['checks'].values()) and a['receipt']['whole_wall_seconds'] <= 400 for a in result['audits'])
reports = {}
for seed in (20261026, 20261028):
    arms = {run['arm']: run for run in result['runs'] if run['seed'] == seed}
    assert set(arms) == {'control', 'candidate'}
    for run in arms.values():
        assert run['whole_wall_seconds'] < 3600 and run['result']['status'] == 'completed'
    candidate, control = arms['candidate']['result'], arms['control']['result']
    initial = candidate['initial_validation']['groups']
    final = candidate['best_validation']['groups']
    assert initial == control['initial_validation']['groups']
    metadata = {arm: json.loads((Path(run['directory']) / 'metadata.json').read_text()) for arm, run in arms.items()}
    assert metadata['candidate']['config']['panels']['groups'] == metadata['control']['config']['panels']['groups']
    old, new = final['anchor'], final['broader']
    old0, new0 = initial['anchor'], initial['broader']
    gain = control['best_validation']['selection_score'] - candidate['best_validation']['selection_score']
    changes = {
        'broader_policy_ce_gain': new0['policy_ce'] - new['policy_ce'],
        'broader_value_ce_gain': new0['value_ce'] - new['value_ce'],
        'broader_qmae_gain': new0['value_mae'] - new['value_mae'],
        'anchor_policy_ce_rise': old['policy_ce'] - old0['policy_ce'],
        'anchor_value_ce_rise': old['value_ce'] - old0['value_ce'],
        'anchor_qmae_rise': old['value_mae'] - old0['value_mae'],
        'macro_total_ce_gain_vs_control': gain,
    }
    checks = {
        'broader_policy_gain_at_least_005': changes['broader_policy_ce_gain'] >= 0.05,
        'broader_value_gain_at_least_003': changes['broader_value_ce_gain'] >= 0.03,
        'broader_qmae_gain_at_least_0015': changes['broader_qmae_gain'] >= 0.015,
        'anchor_policy_rise_at_most_003': changes['anchor_policy_ce_rise'] <= 0.03,
        'anchor_value_rise_at_most_002': changes['anchor_value_ce_rise'] <= 0.02,
        'anchor_qmae_rise_at_most_0015': changes['anchor_qmae_rise'] <= 0.015,
        'macro_gain_vs_control_at_least_005': gain >= 0.05,
    }
    selected = {}
    for arm, run in arms.items():
        checkpoint = Path(run['directory']) / 'checkpoints' / f"step-{run['result']['best_step']:06d}"
        assert digest(checkpoint / 'model.safetensors') == run['result']['best_weights_sha256']
        selected[arm] = {'directory': str(checkpoint), 'model_sha256': run['result']['best_weights_sha256'], 'step': run['result']['best_step']}
    reports[str(seed)] = {'passed': all(checks.values()), 'checks': checks, 'changes': changes,
                          'candidate_initial': candidate['initial_validation'],
                          'candidate_selected': candidate['best_validation'],
                          'control_selected': control['best_validation'], 'selected': selected}
passed = all(report['passed'] for report in reports.values())
receipt = {
    'status': 'pass-learning-only' if passed else 'failed-learning-no-games',
    'both_seeds_passed': passed, 'seeds': reports, 'primary_seed': 20261026,
    'training_source_commit': profile['source_commit'],
    'registration_sha256': profile['preregistration_sha256'],
    'controller_terminal_result_sha256': digest(directory / 'result.json'),
    'script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started,
    'scope': 'Once-only registered point-estimate learning/retention gates on each single macro-selected checkpoint. No game strength/self-learning/promotion claim; secondary seed cannot replace primary.',
}
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'seeds': {seed: {'passed': r['passed'], 'changes': r['changes']} for seed, r in reports.items()}}), flush=True)

import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import chess
import mlx.core as mx
import numpy as np
import torch

from harbichess.backends.pairwise_network import HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork
from harbichess.backends.torch_network import load_weights, sha256
from harbichess.chess.actions import legal_action_indices
from harbichess.chess.encoding import BoardEncoder

started=time.perf_counter();torch.set_num_threads(1);mx.set_default_device(mx.cpu)
root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');directory=root/'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-training-controller-20261004'
result=json.loads((directory/'result.json').read_text());assert result['status']=='completed-awaiting-learning-gates-no-games'
assert sha256(Path('/workspace/work/harbichess/common-validation-pinned/src/harbichess/backends/torch_network.py'))==sha256(Path(__import__('harbichess.backends.torch_network',fromlist=['']).__file__))
assert sha256(root/'docs/research/UFUK-width-latency-probes-20261004.json')=='1089fd0cca308c24bb040a840352d0ad18aa85a7bdcd17608133456bf08bed9f'
arms={f"seed-{run['seed']}-{run['arm']}":{'selected_checkpoint':str(Path(run['directory'])/'checkpoints'/f"step-{run['result']['best_step']:06d}"),'selected_weights_sha256':run['result']['best_weights_sha256']} for run in result['runs']}
probes=root/'docs/research/UFUK-width-latency-probes-20261004.json';boards=[]
for row in json.loads(probes.read_text())['positions']:
    board=chess.Board(row['root_fen'])
    for move in row['moves']:board.push_uci(move)
    assert board.fen()==row['fen'];boards.append(board)
inputs=torch.tensor([BoardEncoder().encode_board(b).values for b in boards]).reshape(-1,8,8,104)
errors={}
with torch.no_grad():
    for name,arm in arms.items():
        path=root/arm['selected_checkpoint']/'model.safetensors'
        assert sha256(path)==arm['selected_weights_sha256']
        model=load_weights(path).eval();mlx=HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork.from_portable(path);mlx.eval()
        a=model(inputs);b=mlx(mx.array(inputs.numpy()));mx.eval(b)
        current={}
        for kind,x,y in zip(('full_policy','wdl'),a,b,strict=True):
            actual=np.array(y);np.testing.assert_allclose(x.numpy(),actual,atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5);current[kind]=float(np.max(np.abs(x.numpy()-actual)))
        masked=[]
        for i,board in enumerate(boards):
            actions=torch.tensor([legal_action_indices(board)])
            a=model.masked_policy_value(inputs[i:i+1],actions);b=mlx.masked_policy_value(mx.array(inputs[i:i+1].numpy()),mx.array(actions.numpy()));mx.eval(b)
            for x,y in zip(a,b,strict=True):
                actual=np.array(y);np.testing.assert_allclose(x.numpy(),actual,atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5);masked.append(float(np.max(np.abs(x.numpy()-actual))))
        current['legal_masked_max']=max(masked);errors[name]=current
receipt={'status':'pass','source_commit':result['profile']['source_commit'],'weights':{name:arm['selected_weights_sha256'] for name,arm in arms.items()},'errors':errors,'probe_sha256':sha256(probes),'probes':len(boards),'device':'Torch CPU and actual MLX CPU; Apple Metal/CUDA unavailable','tolerance':{'atol':2e-5,'rtol':2e-5},'wall_seconds':time.perf_counter()-started,'script_sha256':sha256(Path(__file__)),'scope':'Actual selected models from all four completed controlled runs, no optimizer updates. Full4672policy/WDL and legal masked outputs on18truehistory probes; TorchCPU and MLXCPU. Weights portability is not cross-framework optimizer transfer. AppleMetal/CUDA unavailable.'}
p=directory/'trained-portable-parity.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time

root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
work = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess')
pin = work / 'broad-arena-pinned'
python = root / '.venv/bin/python'
source = '70c612572e03f562f21469e546823244083a3b4a'
training = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-training-controller-20261004'
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-strength-arena-20261004'
book = root / 'docs/research/UFUK-broad-history-strength-opening-splits-20261004.json'
engine = work / 'stockfish/stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal'

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

learning = json.loads((training / 'learning-gates.json').read_text())
assert learning['status'] == 'pass-learning-only' and learning['both_seeds_passed']
assert all(row['passed'] for row in learning['seeds'].values())
assert learning['primary_seed'] == 20261026
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=pin, text=True).strip() == source
assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=pin, text=True) == ''
assert digest(book) == 'd3b9a49e3c60cdce62a672fbfc8ae8ab2a5167ed38cc5781432a8559e0891765'
assert digest(engine) == '0f83d24cc46d2c66c60f16001af5444873bc112b7d028594513426894c12da19'
selected = learning['seeds']['20261026']['selected']
candidate = Path(selected['candidate']['directory']) / 'model.safetensors'
control = Path(selected['control']['directory']) / 'model.safetensors'
initial = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors'
assert digest(candidate) == selected['candidate']['model_sha256']
assert digest(control) == selected['control']['model_sha256']
assert digest(initial) == '18f2aae5a4dca317229b87af17ee393a4e786db3369e54aaf32c926a811cb5ae'
directory.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
started = time.perf_counter()
profile = {'source_commit': source, 'script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)),
           'strength_preregistration_sha256': digest(root / 'docs/runs/UFUK-broad-history-strength-preregistration-20261004.md'),
           'learning_gates_sha256': digest(training / 'learning-gates.json'),
           'book_sha256': digest(book), 'roots': 48, 'games_per_arm': 96,
           'whole_seconds_per_arm': 3600, 'memory_stop_bytes': 15 * 1024**3,
           'disk_min_free_bytes': 8 * 1024**3, 'seed': 20261027,
           'scope': 'Five preregistered sequential strength controls; no concurrent training/benchmark, no auto promotion.'}
(directory / 'profile.json').write_text(json.dumps(profile, indent=2) + '\n')
arms = [('candidate-vs-initial', candidate, initial), ('candidate-vs-control', candidate, control),
        ('candidate-vs-stockfish512', candidate, 'stockfish'),
        ('control-vs-stockfish512', control, 'stockfish'), ('initial-vs-stockfish512', initial, 'stockfish')]
receipts = []
try:
    for name, weights, opponent in arms:
        arm_started = time.perf_counter()
        deadline = arm_started + 3600
        command = [str(python), '-m', 'harbichess.evaluation.portable_arena', str(weights), str(opponent),
                   '--simulations', '16', '--candidate-root-actions', '4', '--opponent-root-actions', '4',
                   '--nodes', '512', '--max-plies', '400', '--seed', '20261027', '--threads', '1',
                   '--opening-pairs', '48', '--openings', str(book), '--output', str(directory / (name + '.json')),
                   '--progress', str(directory / (name + '-progress.jsonl')),
                   '--wall-seconds', str(deadline - time.perf_counter())]
        if opponent == 'stockfish':
            command += ['--stockfish', str(engine), '--record-engine-nodes']
        receipt = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'cwd': str(pin), 'source_commit': source,
                   'PYTHONPATH': str(pin / 'src'), 'whole_wall_ceiling_seconds': 3600, 'started_epoch': time.time()}
        (directory / (name + '-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
        failure = None
        print(json.dumps({'arm_started': name}), flush=True)
        with (directory / (name + '.stdout.log')).open('x') as stdout, (directory / (name + '.stderr.log')).open('x') as stderr:
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=pin, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(pin / 'src'), 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1'},
                                       stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
            while process.poll() is None:
                memory = int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current').read_text())
                free = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
                if time.perf_counter() >= deadline:
                    failure = 'whole arm budget exhausted; no extension'
                elif memory > profile['memory_stop_bytes']:
                    failure = 'memory current including cache>15GiB'
                elif free < profile['disk_min_free_bytes']:
                    failure = 'disk free<8GiB'
                (directory / 'progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'running', 'arm': name, 'pid': process.pid,
                     'whole_elapsed_seconds': time.perf_counter() - arm_started, 'memory_current_bytes': memory, 'disk_free_bytes': free}, indent=2) + '\n')
                if failure:
                    try:
                        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                    try:
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        process.wait(timeout=5)
                    break
                time.sleep(2)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - arm_started
        if elapsed >= 3600 and failure is None:
            failure = 'whole deadline exceeded at completed return'
        receipt.update(returncode=process.returncode, failure=failure, whole_wall_seconds=elapsed, finished_epoch=time.time())
        (directory / (name + '-receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
        receipts.append(receipt)
        if failure or process.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('incomplete arm: ' + name)
        data = json.loads((directory / (name + '.json')).read_text())
        assert len(data['games']) == 96
        print(json.dumps({'arm_completed': name, 'whole_wall_seconds': elapsed, 'summary': data['summary']}), flush=True)
    final = {'status': 'completed-awaiting-independent-game-audit-and-strength-gates', 'profile': profile,
             'arms': receipts, 'stage_whole_wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started}
except Exception as error:
    final = {'status': 'failed-or-incomplete', 'profile': profile, 'arms': receipts,
             'error': repr(error), 'stage_whole_wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started}
    (directory / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(final, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(final), flush=True)
    raise
(directory / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(final, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': final['status']}), flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import time

import chess

from harbichess.evaluation import paired_comparison

root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
directory = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-strength-arena-20261004'
started = time.perf_counter()
output = directory / 'independent-game-audit-and-strength-gates.json'
assert not output.exists()

def digest(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()

terminal = json.loads((directory / 'result.json').read_text())
assert terminal['status'] == 'completed-awaiting-independent-game-audit-and-strength-gates'
learning = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-training-controller-20261004/learning-gates.json').read_text())
assert learning['status'] == 'pass-learning-only' and learning['both_seeds_passed']
selected = learning['seeds']['20261026']['selected']
book_path = root / 'docs/research/UFUK-broad-history-strength-opening-splits-20261004.json'
book = json.loads(book_path.read_text())['splits']['arena']
assert len(book) == 48 and digest(book_path) == terminal['profile']['book_sha256']
initial_sha = '18f2aae5a4dca317229b87af17ee393a4e786db3369e54aaf32c926a811cb5ae'
candidate_sha, control_sha = (selected[name]['model_sha256'] for name in ('candidate', 'control'))
games_by_arm, reports, total_plies, new_plies = {}, {}, 0, 0
for receipt in terminal['arms']:
    name = receipt['name']
    assert receipt['whole_wall_seconds'] < 3600 and receipt['failure'] is None and receipt['returncode'] == 0
    data = json.loads((directory / (name + '.json')).read_text())
    assert data['source_commit'] == '70c612572e03f562f21469e546823244083a3b4a'
    expected_sha = control_sha if name.startswith('control-') else initial_sha if name.startswith('initial-') else candidate_sha
    assert data['candidate_sha256'] == expected_sha
    if name in ('candidate-vs-initial', 'candidate-vs-control'):
        assert data['opponent_sha256'] == (initial_sha if name.endswith('initial') else control_sha)
        assert data['opponent_root_actions'] == 4
    else:
        assert data['stockfish_sha256'] == '0f83d24cc46d2c66c60f16001af5444873bc112b7d028594513426894c12da19'
        assert data['stockfish_nodes'] == 512 and data['stockfish_threads'] == 1 and data['stockfish_hash_mib'] == 16
    assert data['candidate_root_actions'] == 4 and data['neural_simulations_per_move'] == 16
    assert data['neural_threads'] == 1 and data['seed'] == 20261027 and data['max_plies'] == 400
    assert data['opening_source_sha256'] == digest(book_path)
    assert len(data['games']) == 96
    assert data['summary']['capped_games'] == sum(g['termination'] == 'max_plies' for g in data['games'])
    assert data['summary']['terminal_draws'] == sum(g['score'] == 0.5 and g['termination'] != 'max_plies' for g in data['games'])
    assert data['summary']['wins'] == sum(g['score'] == 1 for g in data['games'])
    assert data['summary']['losses'] == sum(g['score'] == 0 for g in data['games'])
    assert data['summary']['score'] == sum(g['score'] for g in data['games']) / 96
    trace = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / (name + '-progress.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [event['game'] for event in trace if event['type'] == 'game_end'] == data['games']
    starts = [event for event in trace if event['type'] == 'game_start']
    moves = [event for event in trace if event['type'] == 'move']
    assert len(starts) == 96
    expected_events = []
    node_counts, move_times = [], []
    for index, game in enumerate(data['games']):
        pair, color = index // 2, 'white' if index % 2 == 0 else 'black'
        prefix = book[pair]['opening']['moves']
        assert game['opening_pair'] == pair and game['candidate_color'] == color
        assert game['opening'] == prefix and game['moves'][:len(prefix)] == prefix
        assert starts[index]['pair'] == pair and starts[index]['color'] == color and starts[index]['opening'] == prefix
        board = chess.Board()
        for offset, uci in enumerate(game['moves']):
            if offset >= len(prefix):
                assert board.outcome(claim_draw=True) is None, 'played beyond registered terminal convention'
            move = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
            assert move in board.legal_moves
            board.push(move)
            if offset + 1 == len(prefix):
                assert board.fen() == book[pair]['opening']['fen']
        ending = board.outcome(claim_draw=True)
        if ending is None:
            assert game['termination'] == 'max_plies' and game['plies'] == 400 and game['score'] == 0.5
        else:
            assert ending.termination.name.lower() == game['termination']
            assert game['score'] == (0.5 if ending.winner is None else float(ending.winner == (color == 'white')))
        assert game['plies'] == len(game['moves']) <= 400
        assert len(game['move_wall_seconds']) == len(game['moves']) - len(prefix)
        assert all(math.isfinite(value) and value >= 0 for value in game['move_wall_seconds'])
        for ply in range(len(prefix) + 1, len(game['moves']) + 1):
            expected_events.append((pair, color, ply, game['moves'][ply - 1], game['move_wall_seconds'][ply - len(prefix) - 1]))
        if 'stockfish' in name:
            engine_white = color != 'white'
            expected = [ply for ply in range(len(prefix) + 1, len(game['moves']) + 1) if (ply % 2 == 1) == engine_white]
            assert [item['ply'] for item in game['stockfish_nodes_by_move']] == expected
            assert all(type(item['nodes']) is int and item['nodes'] >= 0 for item in game['stockfish_nodes_by_move'])
            node_counts += [item['nodes'] for item in game['stockfish_nodes_by_move']]
        total_plies += len(game['moves'])
        new_plies += len(game['moves']) - len(prefix)
        move_times += game['move_wall_seconds']
    assert [(e['pair'], e['color'], e['ply'], e['move'], e['wall_seconds']) for e in moves] == expected_events
    if node_counts:
        assert sum(node_counts) == data['stockfish_actual_nodes']
    games_by_arm[name] = data['games']
    reports[name] = {'summary': data['summary'], 'whole_wall_seconds': receipt['whole_wall_seconds'],
                     'arena_internal_wall_seconds': data['wall_seconds'], 'nn_positions': data['evaluated_positions'],
                     'new_plies': len(move_times), 'new_plies_per_whole_second': len(move_times) / receipt['whole_wall_seconds'],
                     'move_median_seconds': statistics.median(move_times),
                     'move_p95_seconds': sorted(move_times)[int(0.95 * len(move_times))],
                     'engine_actual_nodes': sum(node_counts), 'engine_moves': len(node_counts),
                     'engine_actual_node_minmax': [min(node_counts), max(node_counts)] if node_counts else None}
comparisons = {name: paired_comparison.compare(games_by_arm[name]) for name in ('candidate-vs-initial', 'candidate-vs-control')}
comparisons['stockfish-candidate-minus-control'] = paired_comparison.compare(games_by_arm['candidate-vs-stockfish512'], games_by_arm['control-vs-stockfish512'])
checks = {'caps_at_most_five_percent_every_arm': all(row['summary']['capped_games'] / 96 <= 0.05 for row in reports.values())}
for name in ('candidate-vs-initial', 'candidate-vs-control'):
    row = comparisons[name]
    checks[name + '-score-above-060'] = row['mean'] > 0.60
    checks[name + '-adjusted-lower-above-050'] = row['bootstrap_pair_adjusted'][0] > 0.50
    checks[name + '-worstcase-unknown-bound-above-050'] = row['score_bounds_unknown_caps'][0] > 0.50
delta = comparisons['stockfish-candidate-minus-control']
checks['stockfish-score-delta-above-010'] = delta['mean'] > 0.10
checks['stockfish-adjusted-delta-lower-above-zero'] = delta['bootstrap_pair_adjusted'][0] > 0
report = {'status': 'pass-integrity', 'strength_gate_passed': all(checks.values()), 'strength_checks': checks,
          'played_games': 480, 'all_legal_replayed_plies_including_prefixes': total_plies, 'actually_played_new_plies': new_plies,
          'reports': reports, 'primary_comparisons': comparisons, 'source_commit': terminal['profile']['source_commit'],
          'script_sha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'paired_comparison_sha256': digest(Path(paired_comparison.__file__)),
          'book_sha256': digest(book_path), 'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - started,
          'scope': 'Every actual move/true history/claim-draw convention/colour/root/outcome/engine nodes/durable trace checked. Three registered50000whole-family Bonferroni contrasts; ordinary95%descriptive. Strength pass remains separate from latency,self-learning,teacher superiority,Stockfish-level,Elo and novelty.'}
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
